title: swartzia crocea
intro: Swartzia crocea, commonly known as the African dogwood or yellow dogwood, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing fever and inflammation, and its therapeutic actions, which include acting as an analgesic and an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Swartzia crocea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and benefits of using Swartzia crocea for medicinal purposes.
